name: Electric Fence

source.title: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun

disable: Crafting or DC 28 Thievery check (expert) to disconnect the fence from its magitech power source
reset: The trap automatically resets. If deactivated or disabled, the trap doesn't reset.

items.name: Shock
items.text:
Trigger A creature touches the fence directly or with a tool or weapon

---
Effect The fence deals 6d12 electricity damage to the triggering creature (DC 26 basic Reflex save).

text: A locked, wrought iron fence with bars spaced inches apart is magically electrified.
